//: Example combine map for Emporia_Energy.py. Copy to circuit_map.json and edit, or just generate one for your own panel: python Emporia_Energy.py --generate-circuit-map
//2: Each entry sums its member channels into ONE reported circuit -- typically the two legs of a 240V circuit. The key is the name the combined circuit reports under. Keys starting with // or _ are comments and are ignored.
//3: A member can be written three ways, shown below. An entry matching fewer than two channels is reported as a warning and left uncombined, so a typo never silently drops data.
_Down Comp: a bare channel number, unambiguous when the account has one device
_Water Heater: a channel name, which matches EVERY channel with that name -- the case where the Emporia app gives both legs the same name
_Well: members can be mixed, and a group can hold three or more channels
